The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's Western Climate Assessment is a report that addresses a range of issues, from shifts in mountain snowpack to projections for summer drought conditions. Shalini Chen, a student researching regional hydrology, is examining a graph in the report that shows the average annual precipitation recorded in three western river basins across four consecutive water years from 2018 to 2022. Chen wants to determine in which water year the Colorado basin received its lowest precipitation. Consulting the graph, she finds that this year was the ______
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement about precipitation in the Colorado basin. According to the graph, the Colorado basin received approximately 9 inches of precipitation in the 2020/21 water year, which is the lowest value for that basin across the four water years shown.
